titulo.alumno: A condition in a notice · Possibility and condition

intro: Part 3: a condition in a notice. Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

texto: «Hvis» introduces a condition. In an open possibility the present is normally used; in an imagined situation the past can appear with «ville» in the main clause. Pay attention to the context, not only to the verb form.
Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

frases.estudio: Du får adgang, hvis du viser dit kort.
frases.alumno: You will get access if you show your card.

frases.estudio: Hvis kortet er udløbet, skal du bestille et nyt.
frases.alumno: If the card has expired, you must order a new one.
